description: Use this when the user asks for a statement they converted before, wants to download one again, or asks what they have converted. Lists the statements saved to their PivotBank account, newest first (20 unless a limit is given, at most 50), each with its bank, period, row count and a link to download it as Excel, CSV, QuickBooks (QBO), Xero (OFX) or QIF. Free with a PivotBank account.

limit.description: How many statements to list, newest first. Defaults to 20.

name: list_statements
title: Your saved statements
